newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-YUGOSLAV INTERNATIONAL SIGNS FOR LENS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-YUGOSLAV INTERNATIONAL SIGNS FOR LENS.

text.p: Bastia's Yugoslav international striker Anto Drobnjak signed a three-year contract with fellow French first division side Lens on Thursday.
The contract signed by Drobnjak, who has scored 17 league goals this season, is worth 15 million francs ($3 million), according to sources close to the northern club.
Former Lens player Daniel Leclercq takes over as coach with Roger Lemerre standing down after accepting the job on an interim basis following the sacking in mid-season of Slavo Muslin.
Lemerre, with Leclercq as assistant, has steered Lens clear of relegation in the closing weeks of the season.
